evidence: Assistant Console reads role, tasks, checkpoints, memory, and trace from local SQLite MC.
Assistant backend calls the user's authenticated Claude CLI first.
Ollama remains opt-in fallback when Claude CLI is unavailable.
tasks.status='done' is guarded and only complete_task() may complete work.
Keyword and semantic recall are served from memory_index.
Memory files become graph doc nodes and concept edges during index_memory_files().
graph_nodes stores doc, concept, and component nodes in local SQLite.
graph_edges stores typed relations and traversal evidence in local SQLite.
Assistant state can show graph stats and graph-backed memory context.
Demo Console shows tests, lifecycle, MC state, and proof rows.
